services.desc: Experience the thrill of axe throwing with up to 8 guests for just $25 per person and only $15 per person on Wednesdays! Upgrade the excitement with our $10 ninja star-throwing option (per person), guided by our friendly staff to unleash your inner lumberjack and ninja safely. Whether it’s a birthday party, corporate event, bachelor/ette party, or any special occasion, book your private lane today and take your event to the next level with this unique and adrenaline-pumping adventure!
